inventory_scope: Every Python file under scripts/, src/, and tests/ at the Wave 4 baseline.

classification_rules.MIGRATED: Native/TypeScript tests now prove the product invariant.
classification_rules.OBSOLETE: Retired presentation, manual experiment, or unsupported product surface.
classification_rules.TRANSPORT_ONLY: Python Core/desktop IPC transport or its startup guard.
classification_rules.DUPLICATE: Stronger direct native/build evidence replaces the old bridge check.
classification_rules.FIXTURE_FROZEN: Committed fixture data is retained; Python execution is not required.
classification_rules.TOOLING_RETAINED: Repository-only tooling/guard test intentionally waits for Wave 6.
